checks.name: manager creates version A from master and uses real fullscreen editor with all fields
version B inherits master independently and no-op save never updates modification time
undo and redo work after persistence and selective restore requires confirmation
version-only custom module has editable structured entries, fields, styles and cover/TOC choices
content/design switches preserve current version, template settings and native content
refresh reopens saved edits without new version creation and export center keeps version name
touch-sized tablet permits explicit module ordering and ordinary mode cannot drag
manager deletion needs two confirmations and leaves master and other version intact
different-version writes from stale tabs are rejected instead of silently overwriting either version
confirmed master deletion preserves latest inherited record text without altering version edit timestamp
